title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI skill to investigate policy sync and device health
summary: Hold: the claim that licensing is unpublished conflicts with the documented inclusion of all Purview agentic scenarios. The page also treats the Purview source's applicability as unconfirmed even though Microsoft requires it for embedded Purview experiences. The rollout dates and the existing device troubleshooting controls are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Defender Advanced hunting supports DeviceInfo | where DlpInfo != "" | project DlpInfo for Endpoint DLP device data.
claims.quote:
Go to the Microsoft Defender portal
2. Navigate to Investigation & response > Hunting > Advanced hunting
3. Query the DeviceInfo table
4. Expand the DlpInfo column to view Endpoint DLP device details

Sample query:

DeviceInfo
| where DlpInfo != ""
| project DlpInfo
